messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide Inc announces expansion to 50 new cities. Millfield is listed for Phase 2 deployment, expected in 2 months.

Angela Wright laid off workers: schedule a private consultation with an employment attorney — not the one she works with professionally on behalf of the company, but an independent one she identifies personally. agenda: understand what a negotiated voluntary separation with severance looks like in her state, what triggers enhanced severance obligations, and whether her position as the person managing layoffs creates any particular legal standing or leverage. this is not whistleblowing and not adversarial — it is a competent professional learning her rights before she needs them.

Business closing: Rick Tanner — run the floor as normal. full sales meeting monday morning, standard metrics review, no signals of distress to the team. watch tamika jefferson's behavior closely — observe without confronting. she may be responding to something she's heard or just tightening her own household. note it.

Business closing: Angela Wright — use her existing access deliberately. she processes paperwork — she sees the organizational map before anyone announces it. pay close attention over the next two weeks to: which departments are being asked to document processes 'for continuity,' whether benefits administration queries are being rerouted, and whether senior leadership is having conversations with outside hr consultants or peo vendors. these are the specific signals that precede an hr function restructure. she will know before she's told. she should make sure she sees it.
